profile.headline: Senior Embedded Software Engineer and Controlled Title Holder at GE Aviation
profile.summary: SOFTWARE ENGINEERING EXPERIENCE: Expert in all phases of the software development cycle including architecture, design, development, hardware/software integration, and verification/validation for commercial and military projects, especially embedded real-time microprocessor software development.  A strong real-time embedded software technical background including software / hardware integration experience. Companies include Leidos, GE Aviation, Raytheon, Zhone Technologies, Paradyne Networks, Honeywell, Jet Propulsion Lab, and General Electric Astro Space.

positions.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description: Senior Embedded Lead Software Engineer for the Mission Data Recorder (MDR) for Northrop Grumman Corporation (NGC).  The MDR is a high-speed Network Attached Storage (NAS) device designed to record large volumes of data from various payloads attached to a Mission Computer. The MDR acts as a data server to remote network clients using Internet Protocol (IP) Network File Server (NFS) transfers. The MDR integrates Commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) technology into an airborne ruggedized Line Replaceable Unit (LRU) with removable solid-state hard drives (SSD).

positions.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Senior Staff Software Engineer managing the end of life (EOL) and sustaining teams for the full suite of fully-automated and integrated aviation checked baggage security detection technology solutions. The EOL role addresses hardware and software obsolescence issues and the sustaining role addresses field and customer support.  The hardware configurations use Fedora, Centos, Red Hat, and Scientific Linux Operating Systems executing C++ Object Oriented Design (OOD) software.

Software Team Lead for Reveal Computed Tomography (CT) CT-80 dual–energy Explosive Detection System (EDS). The C++ and C# Object Oriented Design (OOD) software is developed in Visual Studio and runs on multiple platforms including the Primary Viewing Station (PVS), Master Control Station (MCS), and the CT-80 DR+ Scanner.

positions.title: Software Staff Engineer / Technologist
positions.description:
Senior Software Engineer leading the F16 Block 60 Fighting Falcon Advanced Data Transfer Equipment (ADTE) software development.  The primary function of the ADTE is to provide Video/Audio recording and mass storage capability for the F-16 aircraft avionics subsystems. The customer, Lockheed Martin, uses this box to executes their Digital Terrain System and Auto Collision Avoidance System (AGCAS) applications.  The ADTE appears as a file server to the aircraft 1553 and Fiber channel avionics systems.  In this lead role, I developed real-time embedded “C” and Ada software using Wind River Workbench with AdaCore eclipse plugin targeted to Xilinx Multiprocessor System on a Chip (MPSoC) running the VxWorks 7 Real Time Operating System (RTOS). 

Senior Software Engineer leading the F35 Joint Strike Fighter (JSF) Data Transfer System (DTS) Aircraft Memory System (AMS).  The primary function of the AMS is to provide a mass storage capability for the JSF aircraft avionics subsystems using an Fiber Optic interface. The AMS appears as a file server to the aircraft avionics systems.  In this role, developed real-time embedded “C” software using Wind River Workbench targeted to MPC8245 running the VxWorks Real Time Operating System (RTOS). 

Developed real time embedded software for the Civil UAS Avionics program where GEAS and AiRXOS are developing an Unmanned Avionics Vehicle (UAV) air traffic management system, a vehicle control system including a distributed flight management system and a ground control system.  The real-time embedded application software is developed using an Virtual Machine (VM) and Xilinx SDK running on a Xilinx MPSoC ARM 9 Cortex microprocessors executing the PetaLinux Operating System (OS).

Lead Software engineer and developer for DTS programs including the Block 60 F16 Fighting Falcon ADTE, F16 Collision Avoidance System Operational Program, F22 Tactical Data Transfer System, JSF AMS, UH60 DTS, F22 Data Transfer Mass Memory Video Recorder (DMVR).

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer and Control Account Manager
positions.description:
Developed and released real-time embedded “C” firmware targeted to the Motorola PPC for the Raytheon Digital Small Switch (DSS-2A) used in Command and Control Communication Systems. The software was developed on a PC using the Wind River Tornado cross compiler for the vvxWorks operating system and used Clearcase and Perforce for configuration control. As a network gateway, the DSS-2A provides interconnection of dissimilar networks, signaling conversions, and signaling translations. When used with an Integrated Services Telephone (IST), the DSS-2A provides the operational capability from a single-user instrument to communicate over any telephone media, with any number of parties, at the necessary security level to meet mission needs. The functionality of the DSS-2A includes integrated multilevel secure or non secure communications, Multi Level Security (MLS), full-featured Private Branch Exchange (PBX) services, Multilevel Precedence and Preemption (MLPP), Conferencing of dissimilar crypto devices, and Single instrument access to a wide variety of communications assets.

Cost Account Manager (CAM) and lead software engineer for the Raytheon STU III Replacement portion of the E4B Aircraft Digital Voice System. The DVS on the E-4B aircraft provides secure and non-secure communications between users onboard the airplane and connectivity with a wide variety of communications equipment for off-board communications. This red/black switching system is instrumental in supporting the E-4B, also referred to as National Airborne Operation Center (NAOC), capability to support the National Command Authority (NCA) and Joint Chiefs of Staff as a worldwide, survivable and enduring node of the National Military Command System.  This software engineering support included software installation and network trouble shooting on board the E-4B aircraft at Offutt Air Force Base, Nebraska.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed real-time embedded “C”,  C++ and JAVA firmware targeted to the Wintegra Win path 737 CPU (MIPS64-5K Core) for the Paradyne 4200 IP DSLAM. The 4200 IP is temperature hardened 1U rack mountable VLAN aware IP DSLAM containing two 10baseT Ethernet ports, one 1000BaseT Uplink port, 24-48 ADSL or Reach DSL subscriber ports, and Alarm Contacts. The 4200 IP is manageable via a Command Line Interface, an embedded Web Server, or via SNMP. The 4200 IP firmware contains layer 2 filtering, layer 3 filtering, IGMP Snooping, Spanning Tree Protocol, IEEE 802.1Q VLANS, and 802.p priority queues.  These features provide the end user Video, Voice, and high speed internet access. The "C" firmware was developed using a Sun Ultra 5 workstation running Solaris 5.5.1, Windriver’s Tornado 2.0 development suite including their VxWorks RTOS, Atria’s Clearcase configuration control system, and ISO 9001 development process.


Developed real-time embedded Motorola MPC860 “C”, C++ and JAVA firmware for Paradyne’s Bitstorm 2400 IP DSLAM. The Bitstorm 2400 is contained in a 1U rack-mountable enclosure providing 24 channels of dedicated Etherloop transport. Each channel provides up to 10 Mbps of dedicated bandwidth.  The Bitstorm 2400 interfaces with a router or a switch on the WAN side, and Stormport Customer Premises Equipment (CPU) on the LAN side. The BS2400 is an access gateway that supports Layer 2 switching, Element Management, Provisioning, Gigabit Ethernet, and Etherloop DSL technology. The “C” firmware was developed using a PC with Microsoft Windows 2000, and Windriver’s Tornado for Managed Switches (TMS) with Windriver’s vxWorks RTOS, and Atria’s Clearcase configuration control system, and ISO 9001 development process.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer Consultant
positions.description:
Systems Manager for the Mars Observer Verification Test Lab (MOVTL).  Maintained a VAX computer cluster for the MOVTL.  Maintained and enhanced existing real-time 'C' software and DEC Windows/Motif software for the MOVTL.  Ran and debugged command sequences prior to being uplinked to the Mars Observer Spacecraft.  The MOVTL system is a test facility which allows the user to evaluate spacecraft flight software and its interaction with hardware and software components, via the use of non-flight spacecraft hardware, software model subsystems, customized interface electronics, and commercial computer and peripherals.

Designed, coded, and integrated real-time 'C' software and DEC Windows/Motif software, developed on a VAXstation 3100 and running on a Micro-VAX 3800, for the Mars Observer Verification Test Lab (MOVTL).  Systems Manager for the MOVTL VAX computer cluster.

Designed, coded, and integrated Ada software for the Mars Observer and LANDSAT satellite programs.  Used DEC Ada on a VAX 6460 for PDL and code development for the Software Development Facility (SDF).  The SDF is a MIL-STD-1750A debugger/simulator running under VMS used to test flight software written in JOVIAL and MIL-STD-1750A assembly language.  Designed and developed the software that models the Mars Observer and LANDSAT uplink processors.  Also, implemented software that links the SDF top level process, the user interface, to a lower level sub process that communicates to RAID, a MIL-STD-1750A simulator, where the flight software resides.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for requirements definition, design, and development of real time and test software for space related applications using VAX computers, Ada PDL, Verdix Ada toolset, and software engineering standards targeted to MIL-STD-1750A microprocessors.

Formally validated the Centaur Inertial Measurement Subsystem (IMS) software.  Wrote test descriptions and procedures pre DOD-STD-2167A documentation standards.  The IMS software is written in JOVIAL targeted to the MIL-STD-1750A microprocessor.

Taught Ada Programming Language course using the Verdix Ada toolset for Honeywell employees.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for the design, development, integration, and test of real-time embedded Ada software for the Advanced Tactical Fighter (ATF) and the Apache-B avionics operating systems.  This software was developed using DOD-STD-2167A documentation standards on a VAX 11/780 and the Verdix Ada cross-compiler targeted to the MIL-STD-1750A microprocessor. 

Provided engineering services required to design the Fleet Satellite Communications (FLTSATCOM) software for the Navy's Integrated Communications, Navigation, and Identification Avionics (NICINIA) program. This design includes requirements definition per DOD-STD-2167A documentation standards, preliminary design, and detailed design.  The software is written in Advanced Computer Techniques (ACT) Ada on a VAX 11/780 targeted to the MIL-STD-1750A microprocessor.

Provided engineering services required to design the Fleet Satellite Communications (FLTSATCOM) software for the Navy's Integrated Communications, Navigation, and Identification Avionics (NICINIA) program. This design includes requirements definition per DOD-STD-2167A documentation standards, preliminary design, and detailed design.  The software is written in Advanced Computer Techniques (ACT) Ada on a VAX 11/780 targeted to the MIL-STD-1750A microprocessor.
